race.comment: Fascinating race that brings together a variety of formlines with a few kicking off their campaigns. SILVER BULLET (6) resumes and has always been spoken on a horse with some talent. Yet to win first-up, but did run second last prep and gets the blinkers here. Another first-upper, PASADENA (1), returns to Victoria for the first time since the debut third at this track and the two wins last campaign were a good pointer to his talent. Nothing wrong with a couple of Flemington jumpout third placings. TALKIN' ITALIAN (2) has race fitness on a few rivals and only needs to hold his recent form to play a key role. FROSTED IN TIME (13) dominated at Kilmore and warrants obvious respect, especially if the market has a lean to him.
